Peter,
It looks like you may have a hard coded link to a data file that is not in your directory that got uploaded. Would you mind running the following command to update your shinyapps package, and try deploying again.  It should hopefully find the occurrences where that happened. 


devtools::install_github("rstudio/shinyapps")
please keep us posted.
Best,
Tareef
